name: Samsung Biologics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Samsung Biologics Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacturing, commercializing, distributing, and selling of biopharmaceuticals products in South Korea, Europe, the United States, and internationally. Its development services include late discovery, cell line development, process development, analytical development, and non-GMP / CGMP manufacturing.
